disentangled feature representations can improve generalization on relational reasoning tasks, that the disentangling of the latent space is important for generalization, that the generalization gap between supervised and unsupervised training can be closed by increasing the amount of data available, and that the disentangled feature representation can be used as a prior in supervised learning to improve the generalization performance of the supervised model.
